description: This public Mendeley release provides annual planted area, harvested area and production for sixteen field crops across sixteen Jordanian cities and regions from 1994 through 2023. Its named CSV is about 104 kilobytes. The article says the compilers obtained the underlying statistics from the Jordan Department of Statistics. Mendeley version 1 states CC BY 4.0 and allows free access. The observations can supply regional crop-production baselines for water-demand or food-supply scenarios, but they are aggregate reported statistics, not farm-level irrigation meters or a simulation model. Differences between planted and harvested area need to retain their original definitions. Local production practices, crop varieties and changes in official reporting are limitations when using a thirty-year series to estimate future water use. A reviewer-assessed use is checking whether simulated crop-area and output trends match the published regional totals. model-fao-cropwat is a related irrigation-planning model; no input conversion or output comparison was tested. The CSV was not downloaded or examined.
